summary: Under normal market conditions, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in a portfolio of equity and equity-related securities issued by non-U.S. large and mid-capitalization companies that meet the fund’s value criteria. The fund generally invests in the equity securities of issuers the manager believes are undervalued. The fund is non-diversified.
